meta.name: negotiation
meta.description: Prepare and execute negotiations using tactical empathy, calibrated questions, and the Ackerman method. Use when the user mentions "salary negotiation", "contract terms", "handling objections", "mirroring and labeling", "difficult conversation", "deal terms", "BATNA", "anchoring", "how do I ask for a raise", "get a better deal", or "they wont budge on price". Also trigger when preparing for a vendor negotiation, resolving a pricing dispute, or navigating a high-stakes conversation where both sides need to feel heard. Covers accusation audits, Black Swan discovery, and the "Thats Right" technique. For persuasion in product and marketing, see influence-psychology.

howto.what: Claude 会使用战术共情、镜像、标注、校准问题、指控审查、阿克曼议价等技巧，帮你准备和执行谈判，产出谈判策略、话术和评分。
howto.when: 当你提到薪资谈判、合同条款、处理异议、镜像与标注、困难对话、交易条款、BATNA、锚定、如何要求加薪、争取更好交易、对方不肯让步等关键词，或准备供应商谈判、解决定价纠纷、进行高风险对话时触发。

say.text: 我要和老板谈加薪，该怎么准备？
say.note: Claude 会引导你进行指控审查和校准问题准备。

say.text: 供应商不肯降价，我该怎么回应？
say.note: Claude 会使用阿克曼议价法和校准问题帮你应对。

say.text: 客户说预算不够，如何推进？
say.note: Claude 会教你使用标注和镜像技巧挖掘真实需求。
